question.problem: Find the greatest common divisor of $296$ and $185.$
question.worked_solution:
We use the Euclidean algorithm, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}296 & = & 185(1) & + & 111 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 185 & = & 111(1) & + & 74 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 111 & = & 74(1) & + & 37 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 74 & = & 37(2) & + & 0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The last positive remainder is $37.$ Therefore, we conclude that the greatest common divisor of $296$ and $185$ is $37.$ Symbolically, we write

$$
\text{gcd}(296,185)=37.
$$
